Hello, I'm Jason - a software engineer based in Utah. I recently started an engineering position at Northrop Grumman focusing on data pipeline management and analysis. Prior, I served as a lead data analyst at an electrical contractor providing data solutions to leadership. Before that, maintaining and upgrading traceability systems for Autoliv on a global scale. I have deep experience in manufacturing execution software, but also spend time in the broader domain. I enjoy designing and producing completely custom solutions with my cofounders at Layer By Layer.
Outside of a professional setting, you will usually find me active and outside from weight lifting, to exploring the mountains, or adventuring on my motorcycle. I also enjoy working on personal projects learning something new or designing solutions to real problems. Want a copy of my resume? Send me an email request and I will send it over.
Read about what I’m up to and curious about. Questions, concerns or interest in hosting an article here? Get in touch and let’s make it happen!
